[[File:Point_Nadir.jpg|thumb|The Ministry Precinct on the Point Nadir map]]
The '''Ministry Precinct''' was located in the [[Point Nadir]], on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]. It was where the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport's]] government gathered to discuss important plans and developments. It had better life support than any other region of the comet, which meant better air and more stable gravity. Tight security only allowed visitors with proper passes or escort in or out. [[Council Chamber (Point Nadir)|Council Chamber]] and [[Zietta's Palace]] were also located in that area.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
